status: Declared under the operator's standing rules; the version decisions await sign-off.

divergences.stripe: Serves every selectable version, 2011-01-01 to 2026-08-26.dahlia, each in its own shape
divergences.app_emulator: Serves the dahlia release only (2026-03-25.dahlia to 2026-08-26.dahlia) in the 2026-08-26.dahlia shape; any other value, including .preview and endive, gets 400 invalid_request_error
divergences.reason: Monthly versions inside a release name are additive, so one shape serves the whole name faithfully; serving an older release the dahlia shape silently would be harder to diagnose than a 400

divergences.app_emulator: Accepts dahlia versions only; others get 400 parameter_invalid on api_version
divergences.reason: Events are rendered in the dahlia shape only; a label from another release would misdescribe the payload

divergences.stripe: Set by the account's first request, changed in Workbench
divergences.app_emulator: Configuration: STRIPE_API_VERSION, a dahlia version, default 2026-08-26.dahlia
divergences.reason: The emulated account exists before any request

divergences.stripe: The v2 namespace (event destinations, thin events, v2 accounts, meter event streams)
divergences.reason: Needs a second request encoding, page-token pagination and thin events; out of this target

divergences.stripe: Verifies the key exists on an account; an unknown key gets 401 Invalid API Key provided
divergences.app_emulator: Accepts any test-mode secret or restricted key (sk_test_, rk_test_); any other key gets the same 401
divergences.reason: The app emulator issues no keys

divergences.stripe: Refuses a field outside the resource's expandable fields
divergences.app_emulator: Enforces the documented four-level depth only; any field whose value is a known object ID is expanded, and an unknown field is ignored
divergences.reason: Field-level expansion rules are not modelled in this build

divergences.stripe: Saves a result only once the endpoint begins executing; a request that fails parameter validation is not saved
divergences.app_emulator: Saves the first response for a key whatever its status, except a request refused by the parameter checks (unknown parameter, invalid integer, metadata limit), which is not saved
divergences.reason: Those checks run as middleware ahead of the idempotency cache; other handler-level validation errors are still saved

divergences.route: parameters on the spec-documented routes, unknown or pre-dahlia
divergences.stripe: Refuses a parameter the dahlia spec does not list for the route with parameter_unknown
divergences.app_emulator: Accepts the pre-dahlia parameters in handlerOnlyParams (request_validation.go): checkout amount_total, credit_notes currency (and its preview), promotion_codes coupon, quotes currency, amount_total and amount_subtotal
divergences.reason: The handlers still read them, and refusing them would break those endpoints; each entry goes when its handler moves to the dahlia shape

divergences.route: any /v1 route the dahlia spec does not document, and multipart requests
divergences.stripe: Refuses unknown parameters and invalid integers
divergences.reason: No spec table covers these routes, and the parameter check reads form-encoded bodies only

divergences.route: response objects, properties the handlers do not set
divergences.stripe: Returns every documented property, including non-nullable scalars such as a subscription's currency and start_date and an invoice's attempted
divergences.app_emulator: Fills unset nullable fields with null, string maps with {}, non-nullable arrays with [] and customer invoice_settings; omits the non-nullable scalars and customer includable fields the handlers do not set
divergences.reason: Their values are not modelled, and inventing them would be a guess

divergences.stripe: Retries failed deliveries with exponential backoff for up to three days
divergences.app_emulator: Up to three attempts, a few hundred milliseconds apart
divergences.reason: Local and CI runs need prompt, bounded delivery

divergences.stripe: Refuses files over Stripe's per-file size limit
divergences.app_emulator: Does not enforce the per-file limit
divergences.reason: Unchanged in this build; recorded so the gap is visible

divergences.stripe: Refuses a token it does not know with invalid_request_error resource_missing ("No such token: '<id>'") and a reused token with token_already_used; the HTTP status of both, and the param and reuse message, are not documented
divergences.app_emulator: Answers both with 400, param external_account, and the reuse message "You cannot use a Stripe token more than once: <id>."; resolves the six btok_us_verified test tokens to STRIPE TEST BANK, routing 110000000, last4 6789 and never marks them used
divergences.reason: Unverified until a live test-mode call (quirks error-005, crud-009, crud-010): 400 is Stripe's general invalid_request_error status, and the test tokens' bank details and reuse are inferred, not documented

divergences.stripe: Resolves a bank account token a partner such as Plaid issued, to the bank account the partner verified; a Plaid Sandbox token always resolves to routing 110000000, account 000123456789
divergences.app_emulator: Resolves a btok_ token only once it is registered here, to the bank_name, last4, routing_number, country, currency and account_holder_name given; omitted fields default to STRIPE TEST BANK, last4 6789, routing 110000000, US, usd
divergences.reason: The app emulator shares no state with the Plaid app emulator, so the demo registers the token Plaid issued; a bank name other than STRIPE TEST BANK is a deliberate difference that makes a demo account recognisable (quirk crud-011)

divergences.stripe: Takes a token or a dictionary; what happens to the account when the token is refused is not documented
divergences.app_emulator: Resolves the external account before creating the account, so a refused token refuses the whole request and leaves no account
divergences.reason: The conservative reading until a live test-mode call shows whether Stripe creates the account and refuses only the token

divergences.stripe: The API reference and the SDK spec mark external_account required; the dahlia spec lists no required parameter
divergences.app_emulator: Refuses a request with neither external_account nor bank_account with 400 invalid_request_error parameter_missing, param external_account, "Missing required param: external_account."
divergences.reason: Follows the reference and the SDK spec; the error shape is inferred from Stripe's general missing-parameter refusal (quirk crud-012)

divergences.app_emulator: Control plane for tests: health, reset, state, time, faults, and Stripe-specific triggers (fail a payout, fund an account, complete a Checkout Session, advance subscriptions, authenticate a PaymentIntent, create and resolve disputes, register bank account tokens)
divergences.reason: Lets tests drive outcomes that Stripe produces asynchronously or from the Dashboard
